description: Elections Commission - Declare that W. S. Jayalath as Chairman and three other appointments to the Embilipitiya Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in local government positions (Chairman, Vice Chairman, and members) of the Embilipitiya Pradeshiya Sabha under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes at the local government level, including declarations of elected officials to fill vacancies caused by various reasons (loss of seat, appointment to higher position, death). This falls under the Elections category as it pertains to electoral procedures and filling elected positions in local authorities.
